tool.name: Association Test (Logistic Regression)
tool.description: Per-SNP logistic regression: phenotype ~ genotype + covariates
tool.command: python $__tool_directory__/assoc_logit.py --genotypes $genotypes --phenos $phenos #if $snp_annot is not None --snp-annot $snp_annot #end if --covariates $covariates --min-maf $min_maf --missing-code $missing #if str($snp_limit) != '' --snp-limit $snp_limit #end if --out $out_file

param.name: snp_limit
param.label: Limit number of SNPs (for quick tests)

tool.help:
**Description:** Runs per-SNP logistic regression with phenotype and covariates.
**Logic:** - Skip SNPs with low MAF or too few samples. - Output beta, SE, z, p-value, and MAF.
